prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 2D full-body character reference, FRONT VIEW, for a character-design handoff. The two attached images are our already approved original designs, used only as the exact drawing-style / face / adult-body reference. Create a THIRD wardrobe option, not a new art direction.
Match their very elongated ROUND oval colored eyes, narrow sclera and dark oval pupils, softly CURVED delicate upper lids, gentle thin brows, tiny low-contrast nose, small CLOSED smile, soft cheeks tapering to an adult chin. Match the adult proportions and natural arms/legs, around6.5 heads, not chibi or a child. Young adult24.
Fine warm-brown/garment-coloured outlines and CLEAR flat colour boundaries, each surface at most a base and one broad cel shadow plane. Match the attached drawing's soft volume of sleeves/hems/shoes with large simplified shapes. No gradient, fabric texture, tiny creases, photorealism, black wedge nose, open mouth or thick harsh outlines. Plain UNIFORM lightgray#E5E5E5 background, no floor, no cast/contact shadow, no vignette, no props, no text/logos/patterns.
ONE person centered, fully frontal, upright orthographic view. Full body hair top to shoe bottoms with tiny equal margins, square image at least1024x1024. A pose: arms lowered30-35degrees from body, hands relaxed with5 simple softly rounded fingers gently gathered. Preserve reference face/hair/skin/palette family, body mass and detail level. Feet wear indoor house mules and light socks. Do not reproduce any specific fictional or real person's design.
SUBJECT: male,172cm, same short softly swept dark-brown hair and gentle green eyes as attached male designs. Outfit C: unbuttoned muted warm coral cardigan (#DC987E), regular hip/cropped-short length over a plain ivory crew-neck cotton tee (#FDFBF8) with the white hem visible. Broad soft cardigan cuffs and hems, two simple front plackets, no tiny buttons, no pockets or decorations. Roomy dark slate-blue straight lounge trousers (#4B627A), slightly cropped above ankles, large simple cloth planes; gray-taupe rounded house mules (#A0A3A0) with ivory sole and light socks. No jewellery or extra accessories. Intention: tidy relaxed indoor casual, distinct from yellow sweatshirt and mint half-sleeve top while remaining the same approved design family.
